description: Works out what to reorder and how much from a sales CSV and a stock CSV, with reorder points, safety stock, stockout dates and dead stock. Use for inventory planning, purchase orders, or finding slow-moving stock. Read-only, and never uses the network. Results include SKUs and quantities from the files, so they reach the model. It can't place orders.

cover_days.description: Days of sales each order should cover, default 30

date_format.description: dmy or mdy, needed only if the tool reports that dates are ambiguous

lead_days.description: Days from ordering to receiving, default 14. A lead time in the stock file overrides it

limit.description: Most SKUs to return, most urgent first, default 100. 0 returns only the totals

sales_columns.description: Column names by field (date, sku, qty), when detection fails

sales_path.description: Path to the sales or orders CSV

service_level.description: Chance of not running out during lead time: 90, 95 or 99, default 95

stock_columns.description: Column names by field (sku, qty, lead, cost, moq), when detection fails

stock_path.description: Path to the stock count CSV

window_days.description: Days of recent sales to use, default 90

name: inventory_check
title: Check stock and reorder points
